composition_variation: Develop a refined original anime wallpaper of a 30-year-old woman pausing beside a minimalist boutique window on a quiet summer street. Her beautiful adult face features clear green eyes, neat softly arched brows, sculpted cheekbones, a fine nose, and an understated knowing smile. Ash-brown shoulder-length hair has a middle part and softly outward-curving ends. Dress her in an opaque white short-sleeved linen shirt with a modest collar, terracotta-pink wide-leg trousers, flat tan mules, and a plain natural canvas tote. She adjusts the tote strap on her shoulder with one hand close to her collarbone while the other hand carries a folded light cardigan at hip level. Her body remains upright and relaxed, with a slight natural turn toward the window. The glass reflects only pale architecture and sky; display one simple ceramic bowl rather than mannequins or faces. A low cream wall and a small sidewalk planter add clean urban shapes. Warm late-afternoon light produces soft shadows across the pavement, with ivory, dusty rose, ash brown, and muted green accents. Emphasize thoughtful expression and polished contemporary anime craftsmanship. Use an eye-level portrait composition, with one person centered in the middle-to-lower frame and hands held within the central crop. Leave the upper quarter as clean pale sky or light for the lock-screen clock.
